mainEntity.name: How does EarlyJobs match candidates with job opportunities?

acceptedAnswer.text: EarlyJobs uses recruitment technology and recruiter-led candidate review to identify potential matches based on job requirements, skills and experience. Interviews or assessments may form part of the process where applicable.

mainEntity.name: What industries does EarlyJobs specialize in?

acceptedAnswer.text: EarlyJobs supports recruitment across several industries, including technology, BPO, finance, marketing and engineering, depending on the hiring requirement.

mainEntity.name: What is the process for employers to start working with EarlyJobs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Employers can contact EarlyJobs to discuss their hiring requirements. The team discusses the roles and recruitment approach before beginning candidate sourcing and screening under the agreed process.

mainEntity.name: How does EarlyJobs ensure the quality of candidates?

acceptedAnswer.text: EarlyJobs reviews candidates against role requirements through its recruitment screening process. Skills assessments, interviews and background checks should be described as part of the process only where they are actually conducted for the relevant mandate.

mainEntity.name: Is there a fee for candidates to use EarlyJobs services?

acceptedAnswer.text: For employer-funded recruitment services, recruitment fees are payable by the hiring employer under the applicable commercial terms. Candidates should review the terms of any specific programme they use.
